reviews.author: Eugene Tkachevsky
reviews.text:
If you been hunting for a workshop you can actually trust, stop here

My friends and I tried 5 different shops around Lisbon looking for the right one, and Iron Custom Motors — and Yaroslav in particular — is the best I've come across, by a long 3 years way

I brought in a Dyna FXDL that had been through other hands workshop recently. Yaroslav went over the whole bike properly: a full front fork cartrigies replacement and adjastment, new Brembo sintered pads front and rear, a complete brake system bleed with fresh DOT 5.1, new wheel hub bearings, and — the big one for me — the steering column bearings and stem nut sorted out after the previous shops had left the front end worn and unsafe. He also serviced the K&N filter and handled a long list of smaller jobs that had been done badly or ignored elsewhere: cleaning out the breathers, fixing the headlight, cleaning and greasing the axles, servicing the calipers, fitting a proper exhaust clamp. On top of the invoice work, he helped me dial in my suspension setup, which made a real (siginificant) difference to how the bike rides

What sets him apart is the attention to detail. I more or less know my way around motorcycles and engines, so I can tell when someone actually understands what they're doing — and Yaroslav does. He photographs and films every stage of the work, so you see exactly what's going on with your bike. He cleans every bolt, greases every axle, and genuinely cares about getting it right. One small example that stuck with me: the bike came in with no wheel balancing at all, and he managed to get it down to an incredible 30 grams just by fine-tuning rubber and belt pulley. He recommends fair, sensible parts to order rather than padding the bill, and he adapts to what you actually want — from upgrade parts down to the exact type of brake pad.

Long story short: Yaroslav treats the machine like it matters. If you want honest, supers skilled work and a shop that loves the bikes it works on, this is the place

Thank you, Yaroslav🤝🏻

reviews.author: Александр Рыбалко
reviews.text: I was very happy to meet highly qualified specialists! The service and approach simply exceeded all my expectations. I didn't think that my problem would be solved so easily, since this was not the first service I contacted, and everyone refused, but these guys just did it without any extra words in the shortest possible time. I am very glad that I met these guys on the road, huge thanks to Yaroslav and his team for the perfect service and warm welcome!

reviews.author: Yurii Adam
reviews.text:
Finally, I found a motorcycle service I can trust 100% with my bike!

The team not only fixed the issue I originally came in for, but also thoroughly inspected all the related components and systems. They performed a complete service, identified potential problems before they became serious, and made sure everything was in perfect condition.

Now I have total confidence in my motorcycle and can ride with complete peace of mind. Professional, knowledgeable, honest, and genuinely passionate about what they do.

Highly recommended to anyone looking for a trustworthy motorcycle workshop!
